title: Copilot Studio: cost visibility in Preview chat and History
summary: The roadmap facts, credit estimates and documented spending controls are supported. Minor corrections should complete the allocation path, simplify the API call and acknowledge Microsoft's separate guidance that Microsoft 365 spending policies take precedence for covered resources.

claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to show makers consumption costs in the Preview tab for preview and testing usage.
claims.quote: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage

claims.claim: The roadmap plans cost visibility for every historical run as makers review conversations.
claims.quote: as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment reaches the environment allocation pane.
claims.quote: Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Select the environment that you want to manage. ... Under Capacity overages, select or clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant
claims.fix: Set controls[0].ui.path and the rendered table path to 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant'. Add that Allocate capacity on the same pane sets the prepaid allocation.

claims.claim: The printed PUT allocationsV2 operation at API version 2024-10-01 updates environment credit allocations and tenant-pool draw.
claims.quote:
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `
    -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody
claims.fix: Replace the call in controls[0].api and the rendered table with 'PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01'. Remove the appended headers and -d placeholder. Add to the row note: 'The request body sets scope.environmentId, allocatedEntitlements[].allocation.quantity and allocatedEntitlements[].enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled false.' The tutorial's -ContentType "application/json" supports JSON content type; the pre-check's missing literal Content-Type is not a functional fault.

claims.claim: Managing allocations requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.where: summary; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Power Platform environment allocations and linked billing plans govern the prepaid and pay-as-you-go spending described here.
claims.quote: The capacity and consumption controls in the Power Platform admin center apply across Copilot Studio. They aren't exclusive to the Microsoft Copilot harness.
claims.fix: Qualify the allocation guidance and row note: 'These Power Platform controls apply while spending remains managed in the Power Platform admin center. If a Microsoft 365 admin center spending policy covers the environment or agent, its controls take precedence for that usage; Power Platform capacity allocations and linked billing plans do not apply to a covered environment.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/usage-based-billing-manage-copilot-studio-costs, which states 'Existing Power Platform capacity allocations and linked billing plans don't apply while spending for that environment is managed by a resource-based spending policy in the Microsoft 365 admin center.' This is a difference between Microsoft pages, not an unsupported control.

claims.claim: Copilot Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs rather than to the individual maker or user.

claims.quote: To contain prepaid consumption, allocate a defined amount of Copilot Credits to the environment and turn off Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[0].note; Governance controls

claims.claim: The request body identifies an environment with scope.environmentId and allocates MCSMessages credits through allocatedEntitlements[].allocation.quantity.
The body disables tenant-pool draw with allocatedEntitlements[].enforcementRules containing ruleType TenantPool and enabled false.
claims.quote:
enforcementRules = @(
                # Disable TenantPool so the environment is capped at its allocation.
                # Set enabled = $true to let the environment draw from tenant capacity.
                @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }
